description: Implementation of TransactionService for handling payment transactions, including creation, listing, and retrieval of capturable and refundable transactions.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing transaction handling logic, extending generic service and implementing TransactionService interface.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing its details to JSON if not blank.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions for a given order, parsing JSON details into a map.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction eligible for capture based on transaction type and details.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction eligible for refund, considering transaction types and dates.
